evidence: Braun & Hogenberg, Civitates orbis terrarum I, 1572, “vulgo Lisbona”
terms.comment: The form used in the libellī. Cities and small places take no preposition: Lisbōnam volābimus, Lisbōnae sumus, Sintrā (from Sintra); countries take one: in Lūsitāniam, in Lūsitāniā.

lisbona.html: The ō follows Olisīpōn-. The quantity follows the libellī and lexicon-notes-01.

sources: Georg Braun and Frans Hogenberg, Civitates orbis terrarum I (1572), as cited.
